data.title: An application inside the ATS
data.content:
# An application inside the ATS

The machine the candidate never sees: what happens to a submitted application between the form and a human being, and the four ways it can end without anyone reading it.
data.summary: The machine the candidate never sees: what happens to a submitted application between the form and a human being, and the four ways it can end without anyone reading it.
data.subject: one application record

states.title: Submitted
states.description: A form post has been accepted. Fields are validated against the requisition schema; nothing has been interpreted.
states.visible_to_candidate: A confirmation page, sometimes an acknowledgement email.

states.title: Parsing
states.description: The document is converted to structured fields. Multi-column layouts, graphics and custom fonts routinely lose whole sections silently.

states.title: Rule evaluation
states.description: Knockout rules, keyword coverage, years thresholds and ranking features run in sequence, short-circuiting on the first failure.
states.visible_to_candidate: Nothing, for a second or two.

states.title: Queued for human review
states.description: The record is above the threshold and waiting. Queue position depends on source: outbound lists are usually read first.
states.visible_to_candidate: Silence. This is where most of the waiting happens.

states.title: Read by a person
states.description: A recruiter opens the profile. The median attention available per profile is measured in seconds when the queue is deep.

states.title: Advanced to the funnel
states.description: The record leaves this machine and enters WF-001 at the recruiter screen.

states.title: Rejected by rule
states.description: A rule failed. The notification is often queued and sent minutes later, which is what produces a rejection at midnight.
states.visible_to_candidate: A rejection email, minutes after applying.

states.title: Rejected by a person
states.description: Someone read it and passed. What the message says about why is a separate decision, usually a template.
states.visible_to_candidate: A rejection message, generic unless a feedback policy exists.

states.title: Expired unreviewed
states.description: A scheduled job closed the record after a threshold. Nobody read it, and the email it sends is indistinguishable from one that followed a review.
states.visible_to_candidate: A bulk rejection, or nothing at all.

transitions.label: document accepted
transitions.guard: Required fields validate and the file is a supported type.

transitions.label: fields extracted
transitions.guard: Extraction completes, whether or not it recovered the work history.

transitions.label: all rules pass
transitions.guard: Every knockout rule passes and the rank clears the advance threshold.

transitions.label: a rule fails
transitions.guard: Any knockout rule fails, or the ranking falls below the threshold.

transitions.label: a recruiter opens it
transitions.guard: Capacity reaches this position in the queue before the expiry threshold.

transitions.label: threshold reached first
transitions.guard: The record ages past the configured limit with no review recorded.

transitions.label: short-listed
transitions.guard: The profile is put on the active list for outreach.

transitions.label: passed over
transitions.guard: The recruiter decides not to advance it.
